title.name: Pflanzenmonitor Plus
title.sub: Status and limits for every plant, a watering forecast learned from its own history and AI-suggested limits you approve. Moves Plant Monitor plants over in one step.

features.title: Status like plant.*
features.text: OK or problem per plant, with problems, the status of every reading and the species, so cards and templates keep working.

features.title: Every reading on the plant
features.text: Soil moisture, temperature, soil temperature, humidity, illuminance or PPFD, conductivity and CO2, plus VPD, PPFD and daily light.

features.title: Limits you set
features.text: Min and max for every measurement, 5 % hysteresis, which readings count as a problem, a wait after watering.

features.title: Water in X days
features.text: A forecast from the plant's own past cycles, scaled to how fast the soil dries today.

features.title: Last watered, detected
features.text: A jump in soil moisture is a watering. Nothing to press, nothing to enter.

features.title: AI suggestions you approve
features.text: Limits for the species with reasons, safety rules in code, undo any time.

features.title: Rain and frost outdoors
features.text: Rain does not count as watering; frost risk from the hourly forecast.

features.title: Automations
features.text: Problem detected, a reading became too low or too high, a sensor became stale: 43 triggers, 35 conditions.
